verdict.rationale: OCI is a cloud platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. A probe confirms an official MCP server documented under Oracle's own GitHub organization (github.com/oracle/mcp), which delivers the core of the story. The only support is that single probe, with no detail on what the server exposes or how to connect to it. Missing for 10: first-party docs on MCP server setup and tool/service coverage, authentication details for agent connections, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully.
